name: music_compositions
description: Listening test: complete musical compositions using multiple features together
script: var inspect default=5
announce COMPOSITION TESTS — features working together
wait 1
announce 1/6: Ambient — slow pad chords + harp arpeggio
strudel [[c2,c3] ~ ~ ~ [g2,g3] ~, c4 e4 g4 c5 g4 e4] s=harp cps=0.2
wait 10
announce 2/6: Driving — bass line + euclidean melody
strudel [c2 ~ c2 ~ e2 ~ g2 ~, c4(5,8)] cps=0.8
wait 6
announce 3/6: Jazz — chord changes + walking bass
strudel [[c3,e3,g3] [f3,a3,c4] [g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3], c2 e2 g2 c3 g2 e2] cps=0.3
wait 8
announce 4/6: Polyrhythm — three independent euclidean layers
wait 7
announce 5/6: Evolving — slowcat changes bass each cycle
strudel [[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2, <c2 f2 g2 c2>] cps=0.4
wait 8
announce 6/6: Dense — fast arpeggio + chords + rests
wait 6
strudel stop
notify {SCRIPT} "How did the compositions sound?" ["Good","Issues","Broken"] {inspect} blocking
